actions.action: Delete records when their five-minute lifetime ends.
actions.mechanism: Enforce expiration independently of source availability.
actions.implementation: Set a monotonic expiration deadline when a record enters the cache; never extend it on reads. Schedule deletion at expiration and check the deadline before every response. Expired records are misses, never fresh responses.
actions.check: With a fake clock, verify a record is usable just before its deadline, absent at the deadline, and not returned when the source subsequently times out.
actions.risk: Clock and timer handling must remain consistent; delayed cleanup must not bypass the response-time check.

actions.action: Keep the cache within 100 records during concurrent requests.
actions.mechanism: Use atomic admission and least-recently-used eviction.
actions.implementation: Serialize cache mutations. Before inserting a new key, remove expired entries, then evict the least recently used entry if 100 remain. Coalesce concurrent fetches for the same key and bound outstanding source requests; reject excess work without retaining response records.
actions.check: Insert 101 distinct records and verify the expected eviction. Repeat with concurrent completions and assert cache size never exceeds 100.
actions.risk: Least-recently-used eviction can discard useful records during scans; bounded concurrency can reject requests during bursts.

actions.action: Return an explicit unavailable response when the source fails.
actions.mechanism: Combine a source deadline with a circuit breaker.
actions.implementation: Apply a two-second source deadline. On a miss followed by timeout, return HTTP 503 with Retry-After: 10 and a public error code. After three consecutive source failures, suspend fetches for ten seconds, then permit one recovery probe. Continue serving unexpired cache hits; delete expired entries normally, without flushing unexpired entries or caching errors as records.
actions.check: Simulate an outage: verify bounded responses, breaker transitions, expired-entry deletion, retained unexpired hits, and recovery after a successful probe.
actions.risk: These initial timing thresholds require tuning; a breaker can delay detection of recovery.

actions.action: Admit only verified public record fields.
actions.mechanism: Validate data before cache insertion, response serialization, or logging.
actions.implementation: Restrict fetching to an approved public-record endpoint. Use a strict schema with explicitly allowed public fields; reject unexpected fields and invalid payloads. Cache and return only validated records. Log error codes and timing, not payloads or arbitrary request values.
actions.check: Inject a payload containing an unapproved private field; verify rejection and absence from cache, responses, and logs. Verify a valid public record still works.
actions.risk: An allowlisted free-text field may still contain private content; exclude it unless its public-only status can be established.
